fusions.name: Twist in the Wound
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Drives in and rolls the shaft, which deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Clamp at the Bank
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Above the Water
fusions.desc: Takes 2 seconds to use, then increases your damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hours for One Lunge
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 35% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
